text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I stayed up late last night. But it never appeared…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Maybe the ghost is just shy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I wanted to become friends and race together. It seems like it'd be so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I mean… 'Cause it floats, y'know? I thought it'd go fwoosh, or something. Ah well… Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara seems to have a hard time getting sleep. That is a matter of concern.
